title: T011 OpenAPI contract dispatch blocked on T009 main read-back
summary: T011 is authorized and dispatched on a branch from Phase 1 PASS main, but implementation is intentionally blocked until T009's canonical ContentDocument schema is merged and read back from main. The future contract must cover the bounded API v1 surface, RFC 9457 Problem Details, explicit security and concurrency semantics, and a local canonical schema reference without duplicating or weakening ContentDocument. Strict Graphify validation and work-memory validation now pass for the bounded dispatch graph.

claims.text: Phase 1 PR #31 is merged and main@a75f1c2 confirms T001-T008 checked while T009 and T011 remain unchecked.
The current user direction authorizes starting Phase 2 ticket work but does not authorize merging or marking a task checked.
T011 requires a complete OpenAPI 3.1 v1 contract covering public, reader, editorial/publisher, media, taxonomy, provenance, offline and optional SIWE operations.
T011 must reference T009's canonical ContentDocument schema rather than duplicate a permissive content object.
The T009 canonical schema is currently only on ticket/t009-content-document-schema and is not available from main.
OpenAPI implementation and final proof are blocked until T009 main read-back; the dispatch-only artifacts are reviewable without weakening the contract boundary.
The repaired T011 Graphify graph passes strict validation with 10 nodes, 12 edges, a complete loop registry and an L3 route for the external T009 dependency.
T009 current-head CI/Security and review threads pass, while the canonical schema remains absent from main; T011's implementation gate is still blocked.

decision.context: Phase 1 foundation is complete, T009 is the canonical content boundary, and T011 is the next API contract slice.
decision.chosen: Dispatch T011 with explicit dependency and governance evidence, then implement the contract only after T009 main read-back.
alternatives: Duplicate ContentDocument definitions inside OpenAPI before T009 is merged.
Use a permissive object schema and defer safety to runtime renderers.
Implement runtime endpoints or the generated client in the T011 slice.
tradeoffs: The dispatch PR is useful and auditable but does not yet deliver contracts/openapi.yaml.
T011 waits on T009, preserving a single source of truth and a resolvable local $ref.
Runtime authorization, rate limiting, audit, provider rights and generated-client parity remain later proofs.
Workflow-clean T009 reduces implementation uncertainty but does not replace the main read-back or human merge gate.
decision.invalidation: If tasks.md, the API Contract Surface plan, ADR-0003/0004, or T009 canonical schema changes, mark this record needs_update and stop before implementing T011.
decision.proof: Phase 1 main read-back and the T009 PR/dependency state were read back from GitHub; the dispatch, governance, graph, ledger and memory artifacts are saved on the T011 branch. OpenAPI lint and example proof remain blocked. Strict Graphify and work-memory validators pass; the OpenAPI implementation proof remains blocked on T009 main read-back. T009 CI/Security and T011 baseline CI/Security were read back as pass; the canonical schema is still not on main.
